get.summary: Storefronts a product is assigned to, with per-storefront currency readiness.
Products assigned to a storefront, with per-product currency readiness (priced in the storefront's currency?).

scope.description: 1 = Storefront (whole cart), 2 = Product. Enums cross HTTP as numbers.

code.description: Coupon code (ADR-0052). Set => the promotion applies ONLY when the shopper enters this code; null/blank => automatic. Normalized to trimmed UPPERCASE (letters, digits, '-', '_') and unique per tenant among non-null codes; a duplicate is a 400.

maxRedemptions.description: Total redemptions allowed across all shoppers; null = unlimited. Single-use is simply 1. Enforced race-safely at checkout.

maxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: Redemptions allowed per customer; null = unlimited. Customer = signed-in user id, else the normalized checkout email, so guests count.

currency.description: Thresholds and the fixed discount are denominated in THIS currency and are never converted (no FX).

minimumAmountMinor.description: Money threshold, minor units. 0 = none. Both thresholds set are ANDed.

combinable.description: true stacks with other combinable promotions; false = exclusive.

applyScope.description: Opt in to setting storefrontId + the active window; false preserves the current scope/window.

applyCode.description: Opt in to setting code (ADR-0052); false preserves the current code. Null is meaningful (no code = automatic).
